Select approved drugs (max_phase = 4) with an indication of leukemia. Join drug_indication to molecule_dictionary on molregno, and join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter where mesh_heading contains 'leukemia' (case-insensitive). Return chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, efo_id as indication_curie, efo_term as indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind. Sort by chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie, indication_label, and max_phase_for_ind.
